tasks.label: test: mcp-server
tasks.command: docker compose -f ${workspaceFolder}/tests/mcp_server/docker-compose.yml down --remove-orphans -v 2>/dev/null || true && docker compose -f ${workspaceFolder}/tests/mcp_server/docker-compose.yml up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from test-runner

tasks.label: test: pdf-worker
tasks.command: docker compose -f ${workspaceFolder}/tests/pdf_worker/docker-compose.yml down --remove-orphans -v 2>/dev/null || true && docker compose -f ${workspaceFolder}/tests/pdf_worker/docker-compose.yml up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from test-runner

tasks.label: test: graph-worker
tasks.command: docker compose -f ${workspaceFolder}/tests/graph_worker/docker-compose.yml down --remove-orphans -v 2>/dev/null || true && docker compose -f ${workspaceFolder}/tests/graph_worker/docker-compose.yml up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from test-runner

tasks.label: test: integration
tasks.command: docker compose -f ${workspaceFolder}/tests/integration/docker-compose.yml down --remove-orphans -v 2>/dev/null || true && docker compose -f ${workspaceFolder}/tests/integration/docker-compose.yml up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from test-runner

tasks.label: lint
tasks.command: docker compose -f ${workspaceFolder}/lint/docker-compose.yaml up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from linter

tasks.label: reformat
tasks.command: docker compose -f ${workspaceFolder}/reformat/docker-compose.yaml up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from reformat

tasks.label: validate-docs
tasks.command: docker compose -f ${workspaceFolder}/docs-validate/docker-compose.yaml up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from docs-validator

tasks.label: dev: start
tasks.command: docker compose -f ${workspaceFolder}/docker-compose.yaml up --build

tasks.label: dev: stop
tasks.command: docker compose -f ${workspaceFolder}/docker-compose.yaml down --remove-orphans

tasks.label: inspector
tasks.command: docker rm -f mcp-server mcp-inspector 2>/dev/null || true && docker compose -f ${workspaceFolder}/inspector/docker-compose.yaml down --remove-orphans && docker compose -f ${workspaceFolder}/inspector/docker-compose.yaml up --build

tasks.label: inspector: clear data
tasks.command: docker compose -f ${workspaceFolder}/inspector/docker-compose.yaml down -v

tasks.label: create-gh-pages
tasks.command: bash ${workspaceFolder}/scripts/create_gh_pages.sh

tasks.label: k3s: First-time setup (AWS)
tasks.command: docker run --rm -e ACTION=setup -e PROVIDER=aws -e AWS_REGION=ca-central-1 -v ${env:HOME}/secrets/.aws:/root/.aws:ro sinanozel/k3s-anywhere:0.2.2

tasks.label: k3s: Provision (AWS)
tasks.command: mkdir -p infrastructure/state && docker run --rm --env-file infrastructure/configs/csqe.env --env-file infrastructure/configs/aws/csqe.env --env-file .env.secrets -e ACTION=provision -e PROVIDER=aws -v ${workspaceFolder}/infrastructure/state:/app/output sinanozel/k3s-anywhere:0.2.2

tasks.label: k3s: Teardown (AWS)
tasks.command: docker run --rm --env-file infrastructure/configs/csqe.env --env-file infrastructure/configs/aws/csqe.env --env-file .env.secrets -e ACTION=teardown -e PROVIDER=aws -v ${workspaceFolder}/infrastructure/state:/app/output sinanozel/k3s-anywhere:0.2.2

tasks.label: k3s: Check drift (AWS)
tasks.command: docker run --rm --env-file infrastructure/configs/csqe.env --env-file infrastructure/configs/aws/csqe.env --env-file .env.secrets -e ACTION=check -e PROVIDER=aws sinanozel/k3s-anywhere:0.2.2

tasks.label: k3s: Fetch artifact
tasks.command: mkdir -p infrastructure/state && docker run --rm --env-file infrastructure/configs/csqe.env --env-file .env.secrets -e ACTION=fetch -e GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) -e GITHUB_REPO=sinan-ozel/campaign-setting-query-engine -v ${workspaceFolder}/infrastructure/state:/output sinanozel/k3s-anywhere:0.2.2 && mkdir -p .kube && jq -r '.kubeconfig' infrastructure/state/campaign-setting-query-engine.json > .kube/config && echo "Kubeconfig written to .kube/config"

tasks.label: k3s: Restore from backup
tasks.command: docker build -f restore/Dockerfile -t restore-runner . && docker run --rm -v ${workspaceFolder}:/workspace -w /workspace -e CLUSTER_NAME=campaign-setting-query-engine restore-runner

tasks.label: k3s: Deploy
tasks.command: docker build -f deploy/Dockerfile -t deploy-runner . && docker run --rm -v ${workspaceFolder}:/workspace -w /workspace --env-file .env deploy-runner

tasks.label: k3s: Delete deployment
tasks.command: KUBECONFIG=${workspaceFolder}/infrastructure/state/campaign-setting-query-engine-kubeconfig.yaml helm uninstall csqe --ignore-not-found
